cohort: The study included 30 women diagnosed with Peripartum Cardiomyopathy (PPCM) recruited from a tertiary center in Taiwan between January 2002 and October 2018.
finding: The study found that Peripartum Cardiomyopathy (PPCM) commonly occurred around 35 weeks of gestation, and women with antepartum-onset PPCM had increased risks of early preterm delivery and lower Apgar scores in their infants.
gest_age: Delivery time ranged from 26 to 40 weeks, mostly at 35 weeks; antepartum-onset group had a mean gestational age of 32.8 ± 3.6 weeks, compared to 35.5 ± 2.4 weeks in the postpartum-onset group.
